errors.text_span: The first line, colored green, represents Direct Assessment Correlation and appears to start at approximately 0.575 and gradually decreases to approximately 0.525 by the end of the x-axis.

errors.text_span: A second line, colored blue, represents Pairwise Ranking Accuracy and begins at approximately 0.630, decreases to approximately 0.600 around the 4:6 mark, and then rises to approximately 0.675 at the end of the x-axis.
errors.evidence: The description reads the values for the blue line from the wrong y-axis (the left one, 0.500-0.675). The blue line corresponds to the right y-axis (50-80). Consequently, all reported values and the described trend (decrease then rise) are incorrect. The actual trend peaks early and then declines sharply.

errors.text_span: A third line, colored black, represents Average Performance, which begins at approximately 70 and declines to approximately 63 by the end of the x-axis.
errors.evidence: The description reads the values for the black line from the wrong y-axis (the right one, 50-80). The black line's values correspond to the left y-axis (0.500-0.675). Its actual starting value is around 0.575, not 70, and it peaks before declining.
The label on the right y-axis is 'Pairwise Ranking Agreement Accuracy', not just 'Pairwise Ranking Accuracy'.
